claims.text: Applying electro spark deposition to high-entropy-alloy bond coats will improve coating durability and reliability.
Electro spark deposition will enhance adhesion at the bond coat–thermal barrier coating interface.
Electro spark deposition will improve uniformity at the bond coat–thermal barrier coating interface.
Electro spark deposition will refine the bond-coat surface microstructure.
Electro spark deposition will enhance interfacial bonding between the bond coat and subsequent coating layers.
Localized heat and energy input from electro spark deposition initiate microstructural changes in the bond-coat surface.
The electro-spark-deposition-induced microstructural changes improve surface adhesion and uniformity.
Improved adhesion and uniformity produce a stronger, more resilient interface.
The strengthened interface is less prone to delamination under thermal and mechanical stresses.
Electro spark deposition will increase adhesion strength relative to untreated conventionally deposited controls.
Electro spark deposition will increase the number of thermal cycles sustained before delamination relative to untreated controls.
Electro spark deposition will provide longer service life and greater reliability under high-temperature conditions.
The improvement should remain effective under thermal cycling and mechanical stress conditions typical of thermal barrier coating systems.
Extreme temperatures or operating environments outside standard thermal barrier coating parameters may eliminate or reduce the benefit.
The magnitude of improvement may vary with deposition parameters and thermal-cycling regime.
